description:
Because:
 - GHSA-qxc2-j82w-r537 is patched only in 10.5.0, so 9.x is not an option.
 - @faker-js/faker 10 is ESM-only, so jest's CJS runtime throws
   "Cannot use import statement outside a module" in 30 projects.

This commit:
 - Pins @faker-js/faker to 10.5.0 via a root resolution.
 - Adds the faker exception to transformIgnorePatterns in jest.preset.js.
 - Adds it to the three configs that override the preset value.

Resolves Dependabot alert #901.
